name.text: Combined and Joint Variation 4 - Name the variation (drag and drop)

questiontext.text:
Decide which type of variation describes each situation. Drag the correct label into each box.

  1. The cost of maize varies with its mass, so doubling the mass doubles the cost. [[1]]
  2. The number of days to dig a trench falls as more workers are added. [[2]]
  3. The cost of painting a wall varies with its length and with its height. [[3]]
  4. The fare each matatu passenger pays rises with the distance but falls as more passengers share the cost. [[4]]
  5. The simple interest earned varies with the principal and with the time. [[3]]
  6. For a fixed distance, the faster you travel, the less time the journey takes. [[2]]
  7. The fuel a generator uses varies with the number of hours it runs. [[1]]
  8. The time to harvest a tea plot rises with its area but falls as more pickers are added. [[4]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Direct: one quantity changes in the same proportion as another, \(y = kx\).

Inverse: one quantity rises as the other falls, \(y = \frac{k}{x}\).

Joint: one quantity depends on two or more others, all multiplied together, \(y = kxz\).

Combined: a mix of direct (or joint) and inverse in the same relationship, \(y = \frac{kx}{z}\). Look for "rises with ... but falls with ...".
